An electric first half Early exchanges were defined by a sharp tactical tug-of-war, with FC Porto looking to dictate the tempo against a resilient AVS Futebol SAD . The deadlock was broken in the 23rd minute when Roni found space to fire home with his left foot, sending the home crowd into raptures. Despite sustained pressure from the visitors as they hunted for an equalizer, the home side held firm, heading into the break with their noses in front. The equalizer and the surge Following the interval, FC Porto ramped up their offensive intensity. However, the momentum shifted back almost instantly; just five minutes later, Roni restored the advantage with a stunning strike from outside the box. The decisive blow arrived in the 80th minute when Aderllan Santos rose highest to meet a Babatunde Akinsola delivery, nodding the ball into the net to cement the lead.
